plan.title: Treatment-specific gene changes across 4 timepoints
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is a 2-condition x 4-timepoint (t0-t3) time-course bulk RNA-seq design with 3 replicates per condition-timepoint cell (n=12 per condition, n=25 samples listed but design table implies 24 = 2x4x3; treat the metadata as authoritative for actual n per cell) from salmon-derived raw gene-level counts (12000 genes x 25 samples/columns). The research question — which genes change over time in a condition-specific way, beyond the shared time trend — is precisely the interaction term of a two-factor design: DESeq2 with design ~condition + time + condition:time isolates genes whose time-trajectory differs by condition (the condition:time interaction coefficients) from genes that merely trend with time in both conditions (the time main effect) or differ between conditions at a fixed level (the condition main effect). Steps: (1) QC on sample structure via blind VST/PCA/distance heatmap to confirm samples cluster by condition and time and catch outliers or mislabeling before modelling; (2) minimal low-count pre-filter, then fit the full interaction model in DESeq2, extract Wald tests for each condition:time interaction coefficient with apeglm shrinkage, and additionally run the DESeq2 likelihood-ratio test (full vs reduced ~condition+time) as a joint, omnibus test of whether the interaction term matters at all for each gene, reported as a secondary/global check alongside the per-coefficient Wald results (both are DESeq2-native, permitted methods for this design, and answer complementary versions of the interaction question); (3) BH-adjusted multiple testing on both the Wald interaction contrasts and the LRT, at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering; (4) enrichment via over-representation analysis (clusterProfiler) of the significant interaction-effect gene list against MSigDB Hallmark, then Reactome pathways as a second collection, with the universe restricted to tested genes — the knowledge-service check requires ORA (not preranked GSEA) as the permitted enrichment method for this 2-group/4-timepoint interaction situation; (5) cluster the significant interaction genes by their time-by-condition trajectory shape to visualize the direction and pattern of the treatment-specific effect; (6) a consolidated report giving the QC diagnostics, the model, the per-timepoint simple effects and interaction contrasts, the DE and enrichment tables, and a full reproducibility record.
